definitionZh: @scope CSS at- rule 使您能够在特定的 DOM 子树中选择元素, 精确地瞄准元素而不会写入过于特定的选择器, 而不会将您的选择器与 DOM 结构过于紧密地结合 。
sourceDefinition: The @scope CSS at-rule enables you to select elements in specific DOM subtrees, targeting elements precisely without writing overly-specific selectors that are hard to override, and without coupling your selectors too tightly to the DOM structure.
